regions.label: Right ACC
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right ACC, which is where it was aimed.

regions.label: Right OFC
regions.why: Histology scored Right OFC as “maybe”. Probably right, but it was written down without confidence, so anything computed from it carries that.

regions.label: Right white matter tracts (aimed at Right DHC)
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right white matter tracts, not Right DHC. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.
